question: What are the most advanced clinical programs in geographic atrophy?

input.sql:
SELECT p.asset_id, a.canonical_name, a.is_combo, p.max_phase_active, p.max_phase_ever, p.n_active_trials, p.n_trials, p.lead_company_of_most_advanced, p.latest_activity, p.nct_ids
FROM v_programs p JOIN assets a USING (asset_id)
WHERE p.condition_key = 'D057092'
ORDER BY p.max_phase_ever DESC NULLS LAST, p.max_phase_active DESC NULLS LAST, p.n_active_trials DESC
LIMIT 30
SELECT count(DISTINCT asset_id) AS n_programs FROM v_programs WHERE condition_key = 'D057092'

SELECT b.provenance, b.moa_label, b.tier FROM v_moa_best b WHERE b.asset_id IN ('avacincaptadpegol','brolucizumab','ranibizumab','pegcetacoplan','pozelimab','vonaprument','cemdisiran','alk001','tinlarebant','lampalizumab')
SELECT asset_id FROM v_moa_best WHERE asset_id IN ('avacincaptadpegol','brolucizumab','ranibizumab','pegcetacoplan','pozelimab','vonaprument','cemdisiran','alk001','tinlarebant','lampalizumab')
SELECT asset_id, moa_label FROM v_moa_best WHERE asset_id IN ('vonaprument','alk001','tinlarebant')

WITH scope AS (SELECT DISTINCT asset_id FROM v_programs WHERE condition_key = 'D057092')
SELECT coalesce(b.provenance,'none') AS tier, count(*) AS n_assets
FROM scope s LEFT JOIN v_moa_best b USING (asset_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT b.asset_id, b.moa_label, b.provenance FROM v_moa_best b WHERE b.asset_id IN ('vonaprument','alk001','tinlarebant','aavcagscd59','bi771716','avd104','gt005','ionisfblrx','iptacopan')
SELECT asset_id, moa_label, provenance, tier FROM v_moa WHERE asset_id IN ('vonaprument','alk001','tinlarebant','aavcagscd59','bi771716','avd104','gt005','ionisfblrx')
SELECT asset_id, canonical_name FROM assets WHERE asset_id IN ('vonaprument','alk001','tinlarebant','aavcagscd59','bi771716','avd104','gt005','ionisfblrx')
SELECT * FROM v_moa WHERE asset_id = 'vonaprument'
SELECT * FROM asset_enrichment WHERE asset_id = 'vonaprument'
SELECT * FROM asset_nlm_classes WHERE asset_id = 'vonaprument'
SELECT * FROM chembl_moa WHERE asset_id = 'vonaprument'
